Name: Sam Thornton
Bio: After serving as Vice President last year, Sam is thrilled to step into the role of ELC Co-President. Beyond ELC, his campus involvement includes the Enable prosthetics club, hosting a WVFI podcast, and playing guitar for a student band. In his free time, he enjoys baking and wood carving, and is training for his first Ironman.

Name: Joseph Collins
Bio: Joseph is a junior studying mechanical engineering currently living in Baumer Hall. Outside of his role as ELC Co-President, he enjoys working for the Notre Dame Rocketry Team, playing guitar, and taking advantage of the faith opportunities at Notre Dame. Joseph previously served as E-Week Co-Chair.

Name: Kyle Brown
Bio: Kyle is a junior Mechanical Engineering major living in O'Neill hall and is the Vice President for ELC. He has been on ELC/FYEC for the past two years, and it has been a ton of fun! Outside of the classroom, he loves to do any competitive event, from sports to games, and hang out with his friends.

Name: Michael Settles
Bio: Michael currently serves as Vice President of ELC, after previously serving as Director of FYEC, and as Vice President of NSBE, where I previously served as a freshman representative and board member. Outside of leadership, he is a member of the club lacrosse team and an active member of Baja SAE. He is especially passionate about the automotive industry and previously interned with Ford Racing.

Name: Kristine Delelis
Bio: Kristine is a sophomore Mechanical Engineering major in Cavanaugh Hall, serving as Treasurer for ELC this year. Having served as FYEC Treasurer her freshman year, she is also involved with IrishSAT, the GOAT Lab, NDBridge, and is a McNeill Fellow.

Name: Emily Kim
Bio: Emily is a sophomore Electrical Engineering major in Flaherty Hall with a minor in Finance, serving as Secretary for ELC this year. Having served as FYEC Secretary, she is involved in semiconductor research at NDnano and leads regional hackathons with the Innovation Sprint Lab. In her free time, she enjoys going on spontaneous trips and side quests.

Name: Carmen Noe
Bio: Carmen is a senior Chemical Engineering and ACMS double major on the Pre-Med track in Grojean Hall with a minor in Bioengineering, serving as Executive Advisor for ELC this year. Having studied abroad in Berlin, she is also involved with SCNO.

Name: Lauren Starr
Bio: Lauren is a four-year member who has served as Treasurer and on FYEC. Originally from Pittsburgh, PA, she currently lives in Grojean Hall. For fun, Lauren enjoys watching football and spending too much time at the dining halls with friends.
